name: Ta Yang Group Holdings Limited
summary: Ta Yang Group Holdings Limited, founded in 1991 and based in Central, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company, owned by Lyton Maison Limited, that designs, makes and sells silicone rubber products in China, Europe and Hong Kong. Its segments are silicone rubber, retail services, healthcare and hotel services, and online marketing solutions. The rubber goes into consumer electronics, keyboards, phone parts and automotive products.
